So how do you increase your BS?
Say you're at a low BS. For whatever reason. Say you deserved it. Okay, now what?

You're now surrounded by toxic people that often do deserve it. That are reporting you constantly over complete drivel even if you aren't toxic. You can get commends, that isn't enough. You can try to be positive in chat, but that also isn't enough, and good luck with that if you're sub 6k, and it may come off as toxic positivity anyways to toxic people.

So apart from just trying to play well (and many games you can't (and you can STILL get reports anyways)), which isn't enough, what the hell are you supposed to reasonably do?

The behavior score system simply doesn't solve anything. The people who should be punished aren't. I climbed from a behavior score of 4k to 8700, yet the games back at 4k were actually much more satisfying and fun. Currently, 3 out of every 5 matches are extremely toxic—there are so many new accounts, which I’m certain belong to veteran players whose main accounts have very low behavior scores; they just create a new account and keep on being just as toxic. Valve should restrict it to one account per player, and repeat toxic offenders should face much harsher penalties. What’s the point of having a 12k behavior score if you still end up with toxic players ruining your matches?

I've been increasing my BS slowly. I agree with you, it's painful.

Let's say you queue up in all roles, get mid, and your pos5 picks zues after you pick and then he comes mid and fights you for last hits. So you go to another lane and still can't get any farm.

Then, later in the game, you're getting dived literally at the throne, at tier 4's, with all rax up, and no one TP's to help you.

Then, later in the game, your rax are being pushed and the Zeus just sits in jungle and never helps, but he pings your death timer if you die.

In the past, in a game like that, I would often rage quit. The way I saw it was that why should I play with a troll on my team, like why does he deserve to waste my time like that.

I still think it's extremely flawed that you lose 500 BS for abandoning a game, but the troll who caused you to abandon gets a slap on the wrist, like -20 BS. I think intentional trolling should come with actual IP and account bans, but that's a discussion for another thread.


What turned it around for me was when I realized that abandoning was just punishing myself. Now, if I have a troll on my team, I just try to do something else. It has definitely changed the way I play and what heroes I play. I used to play a lot of Spec, for example, but now I know picknig Spec is too risky because you simply can't play Spec if your pos5 is going to troll you. So I pick heroes that aren't as reliant on teamwork. If I get pos1 I will pick something that can gank and play earlier if need be, though, truth be told, I basically stopped playing pos1 these days (due to trolls).

I basically only mid these days, and having absolute trolling lane mates is 100% of the reason why. I don't even need to play mid, I enjoy other roles, but having a lane mate troll me just makes the sidelines unplayable.

So that's what I do. Mid every game. Try my best. If I have a troll on my team, I still try to win 4v5. If winning becomes impossible, I basically check out and start listening to music/talking to my wife while I sort of go through the motions and wait for the game to end.
